name: Happy New Year!
description: A module with garland and snow decoration that creates longlasting atmosphere of New Year for you and the users of your website.
library_dependencies: Snowstorm (https://github.com/ivnish/Snowstorm) — bundled JS, optionally loaded from jsDelivr CDN or a local /libraries/snowstorm/ path
project_description:
A module with garland and snow decoration that creates long-lasting atmosphere of New Year and Christmas for you and the users of your website.

 The difference of the module from the existing ones:

 
 All New Year's and Christmas functionality in one module. 
 Ability to specify the time interval of the module 
 The garland automatically descends under the toolbar, rather than hiding behind it (if the toolbar is used) 
 The garland is automatically lowered under the bootstrap navbar fixed, and does not overlap the menu (if the bootstrap navbar fixed is used) 
 The ability to choose the color of snow in the settings (on the "white" sites white snow is not visible) 
 It is possible to use minified libraries 
 
 Similar modules 
 
 Christmas Snow (was abandoned a lot of years and in 2020 new maintainer is stealing my code) 
 Christmas Lights (Seems abandoned)
